# Changelog {#sec-changelog .unnumbered}

## v1.0.9

[In development (PR #25); not yet on CRAN.]{.text-muted}

**Changes that affect results**

* **Cluster bootstrap with unused factor levels.** When the first clustering variable is a factor with levels that do not appear in the data, `ivDiag()` drew the right clusters but fetched the wrong rows: some draws got no rows or another cluster's rows, and some clusters could never be drawn. Unused levels appear after subsetting a data frame, or when missing values remove every row of a cluster. Each drawn cluster now gets its own rows. This changes the bootstrap standard errors, intervals and *p*-values and `F.bootstrap`, and only in that case. In one design from @lal2023trust, clustered on a factor with 999 unused levels, the 2SLS bootstrap SE changes from 1.62 to 0.46. Numeric or character clustering variables, factors without unused levels, and every example in this manual are unchanged. (#24, thanks [\@leoyyang](https://github.com/leoyyang))

## v1.0.8

[On CRAN since 2026-11-02.]{.text-muted}

**Changes that affect results**

* **Effective *F* with several instruments.** `eff_F()` now partials the intercept, controls and fixed effects out of the instruments, and applies `weights`, as @olea2013robust require. Earlier versions did not, so with two or more instruments the value could be wrong (e.g., 24.55 instead of 85.75). Results with one instrument, including every example in this manual, are unchanged.
* **Factor instruments.** A factor or character instrument now enters every statistic as dummies for all levels but the first. Earlier versions used it as one numeric column for the standard, robust and cluster *F*, the AR test and `tF()`. In one 8-level example from @lal2023trust, the AR *p*-value changes from 0.967 to 0.175. No example in this manual has a factor instrument.

**Bug fixes**

* No more spurious "NaNs produced" warnings from some BLAS/LAPACK libraries; estimates and standard errors are unchanged. (#22)
* `eff_F()` and `ivDiag()` stop with a clear error when the instruments are collinear, instead of returning `NA` or a wrong number.
* `eff_F()` standardizes the instruments internally, so instruments on very different scales or with large means no longer break it. With two or more clustering variables it skips this step, because **lfe**'s repair of the cluster variance depends on scale.

## v1.0.7

[On CRAN since 2026-10-30.]{.text-muted}

**Changes that affect results**

* **AR confidence set on the whole real line.** `AR_test()` now finds the Anderson-Rubin set exactly. Earlier versions searched only within 10 SEs of the 2SLS estimate and could miss part of it, e.g., `[0.0642, Inf)` instead of `(-Inf, -1.1605] Union [0.0640, Inf)`. The AR test of zero effect is unchanged.
* **`ltz()` with `weights`.** The adjustment now uses weighted cross-products. In @sec-sensitivity, the LTZ estimate changes from 3.6088 (SE 0.8112) to 3.7441 (SE 0.7568). (#18, thanks [\@Rok-Novak](https://github.com/Rok-Novak))
* **`tF()` with a very weak first stage.** Below *F* = 4, `tF()` returns an interval covering the whole real line, as @lee2022valid require. Earlier versions used the critical value at *F* = 4, so the interval was too narrow.
* **Reproducible bootstrap.** `seed` now reaches the parallel workers (through **doRNG**), so results no longer depend on the number of cores or change from run to run. For a given `seed`, results differ from v1.0.6.

**New features**

* **Fuzzy RD designs.** `ivDiag()` gains `running`, `cutoff`, `rd.poly`, `bandwidth` and `kernel`, so that only the jump at the cutoff identifies the effect. See @sec-rd.
* **New dataset `mcclendon`** [@mcclendon2014], now the main example in this manual and the help pages.
* **This manual is now a Quarto book** in `tutorial/`.

**Bug fixes**

* The parallel bootstrap works again; a July 2024 change on GitHub made it fail with "invalid connection". CRAN v1.0.6 was not affected. (#12, thanks [\@kjohnsen](https://github.com/kjohnsen))
* Harmless "NaNs produced" warnings in bootstrap resamples are silenced.

**Other changes**

* Bootstrap workers start with `parallelly::makeClusterPSOCK()`; **future** is no longer imported. (#15, thanks [\@HenrikBengtsson](https://github.com/HenrikBengtsson))
* `ivDiag()` no longer calls `set.seed()`.
* DESCRIPTION gives the address for bug reports (#8, thanks [\@olivroy](https://github.com/olivroy); #16, thanks [\@HenrikBengtsson](https://github.com/HenrikBengtsson)) and cites @lal2023trust by DOI.
* Dataset help pages give their sources and licenses. Unit tests added; unused imports removed.
